findings.quote: Treating the triangle as base 4, height 4 gives area 8, correct here; misreading the axes as base 4, height 2 gives Δv = 4 m/s and a wrong answer of 6 m/s.
findings.note: The entry opens by describing a calculation it then calls correct, so half of a common-mistakes entry is not a mistake at all. Only the second clause names an actual error; the arithmetic in both clauses is right.
findings.fix: Misreading the peak of the graph as 2 m/s² instead of 4 m/s² gives Δv = ½ × 4 × 2 = 4 m/s and a wrong answer of 6 m/s.
